definitions.gloss: to triumph; to gloat; to exult in victory
definitions.explanation: To display pride and satisfaction after winning. Often implies showing off one's victory in a way that may be smug or arrogant. Commonly used as a modifier in the form 勝ち誇った (triumphant).

examples.japanese: {勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}った⟦{笑|え}み→笑み：13768_emi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浮|う}かべた→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}って→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧{勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He was gloating after winning the match.

examples.japanese: {勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}ったような⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見下|みくだ}す→見下す：09911_mikudasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、スポーツマンシップ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反|はん}する→反する：11966_hansuru⟧。
examples.english: Looking down on your opponent with a gloating attitude goes against sportsmanship.

notes:
Godan verb (ら row): {勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}る・{勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}ります
て-form: {勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}って
た-form: {勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}った

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}った⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (a triumphant face)
- {勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}った⟦{笑|え}み→笑み：13768_emi⟧ (a triumphant smile)
- {勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}ったよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (as if gloating)
- {勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}った⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (a gloating attitude)

USAGE:
Most commonly used in the past-tense modifier form {勝|か}ち{誇|ほこ}った to describe someone's expression, tone, or attitude. Often carries a slightly negative connotation of smugness.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: To become proud/satisfied — more neutral, doesn't necessarily imply gloating over an opponent.
- ⟦{威張|いば}る→威張る：12224_ibaru⟧: To boast, to be arrogant — focuses on the general attitude rather than specifically post-victory behavior.
